title: My graduation project: medieval - fast Multiplayer RTS
author: reitnos
selftext:
Hello everyone! I'm an entrepreneurship student working on my graduation project: a fast-paced strategy game with no base-building, just battle from the start.  
  
Command infantry, archers, cavalry and artillery, and outplay your opponent with flanks, ambushes and smart positioning in short 1v1 or 4-player games.  
  
We're in beta now and launching on Steam soon. Each match is only a few minutes long, so it's perfect for a quick session.  
  
You'll find more info below. Any feedback through the Google Form would mean a lot, and it only takes a minute :)

I vibe-coded some core battle mechanics, movements and created the army unit-models using the Hunyuan3D model, let me know what you think! 

**Feedback form:** [**https://forms.gle/idwDCU8PiLvaeA44A**](https://forms.gle/idwDCU8PiLvaeA44A)

**Playable Link:** [https://drive.google.com/file/d/13UxRLi8h94ckI94gBdc0CYYxg5SFZdqi/view](https://drive.google.com/file/d/13UxRLi8h94ckI94gBdc0CYYxg5SFZdqi/view)  
(Simply extract the zip, run the Beta Build 2 application, and enjoy :)
